subject: wifi-lab-11 ip override: make flag-aware for consistency with engine ip flag-skip
description: Nancy finding (2026-07-17): after the engine `ip` flag-skip fix (#185), `_app/dark-arts/vault/wifi-arsenal/labs/wifi-lab-11.html`'s own `ip` override (line ~1155) checks `args[0] === 'addr'` literally, so `ip -br addr`/`ip -4 addr` fall through to the SHARED engine and now show the generic placeholder network (192.168.1.100/24) instead of the lab's scenario data (10.20.0.55, MON_INTERFACE, state.monitorEnabled). Before #185 those forms showed "Usage:" (visibly wrong). Non-grading (no completeObjective on that handler) and off the taught path (`ip addr` still works + shows scenario), but it's a 'plausible-but-wrong' cosmetic divergence. FIX: apply the same first-non-flag filter in wifi-lab-11's ip override so `-br`/`-4` forms hit the scenario handler. Low priority. NOTE: ehe-lab-enumeration.lab.html does NOT load LinuxTerminal.js (self-contained sim) — unaffected, despite the cmd==='ip' grep hit.
